Kolte-Patil Homes and Projects in Bengaluru

Founded over three decades ago, Kolte-Patil Developers Limited (BSE: 532924, NSE: KOLTEPATIL) is one of Western India's premier real estate development companies. Driven by the philosophy of "Creation, Not Construction," we build self-sustaining ecosystems and timeless architectural benchmarks.

With an unbroken track record of financial stability and transparent governance, Kolte-Patil has redefined luxury living through its flagship 24K luxury brand and expansive integrated townships.

For homebuyers exploring Kolte Patil homes in Bangalore, the Bengaluru portfolio spans Electronic City, Horamavu, and North Bengaluru. Discover projects such as I-Towers Exente, Mirabilis, Raaga, and Lakeside 24, and compare apartment configurations, prices, floor plans, and amenities.

Architectural Overview

Kolte Patil Raaga is a ready-to-move residential community in Kannuru, off Hennur Main Road in North Bengaluru. The project offers thoughtfully planned 2 and 3 BHK apartments across 12 towers, with 590 homes, landscaped open spaces, and layouts designed for ventilation and privacy with no common walls. Residents can enjoy a clubhouse, swimming pool, gym, indoor games room, sports courts, and children’s play area. Its location connects residents to Manyata Tech Park, Outer Ring Road, Hebbal, and Kempegowda International Airport. Explore Kolte Patil Raaga apartments, floor plans, amenities, and current pricing. Buyers researching Kolte Patil developers in Bangalore can explore Kolte-Patil Developers homes in Kannuru, Bengaluru, with project status, location, and configuration details available to compare.

Kolte Patil Raaga is listed with 2 & 3 Bed Homes across 6 Acres, with ready to move status and possession shown as Ready to Move. Listed floor plan options include 2-BED RESIDENCES and 3-BED RESIDENCES. Residents can explore amenities such as Full-Fledged Clubhouse, Swimming Pool with Deck, Health Club & Gymnasium and Indoor Games Room (Billiards, Table Tennis, Chess), with nearby destinations including Outer Ring Road (ORR) (8.5 Kms), Manyata Tech Park (9.8 Kms) and Elements Mall (9.2 Kms).
